title: Kaitei Daisensou
overview:
I go forth. Into the chaotic blue abyss.

1993. The game that set the shooting spirit of arcade regulars ablaze is now revived here!! Smash everything in front of you, one after another!! Now, everyone, let's go to the sea!!

The polar ice has melted and the flooded world is threatened by the Dark Anarchy Society, whose base holds a superweapon. Take command of the submarine Granvia and fight your way through the D.A.S. forces in this side-scrolling shooter, an arcade conversion of Irem's 1993 original.

Fire torpedoes straight ahead and missiles upward - or both at once - while bombs drop below you. Pick up items to upgrade both weapons, collect Treasure Balls for extra lives, and beat each stage boss before the timer runs out. The screen does not scroll on its own: push forward at your own pace, but there is no turning back.

- 1 or 2 players at the same time, each with a submarine
- Weapons behave differently at the surface and in the depths

我は行く。混沌たる蒼き深淵へ。

1993年。ゲーセン野郎達のシューティング魂を熱く燃え上がらせたあのゲームが、今、ここに甦る!!目の前にあるもの全てを、片っ端からぶち壊せ!!さあ、みんなで海へいこー!!
